resolution.note: laneOfSession, start --lane binding via the PreToolUse Bash hook and manifest-based scope proven by test/lane/session.test.ts and test/lane/lifecycle.test.ts

title: Hooks find their lane through the manifest and scope refuses unbound and out-of-lane writes
body:
Evidence: ADR 0029 decision 2 and migration step 3 (docs/adr/0029-lane-manifest-and-task-writer.md); audit D4a/D4b (scope lets a krn-lane subagent write tasks/ in its worktree and outside it), reproductions listed in test/lane/lifecycle.test.ts header; t-1zptswy and t-48b8v1f.
Outcome: laneOfSession(payload, env, cwd) in src/lane/manifest.ts resolves KRN_LANE_ID, then the agent binding (manifest agents[] written when a krn-lane subagent runs krn lane start --lane <laneId>, seen by the PreToolUse Bash hook through the shell reader), then the checkout, then legacy (an existing worktree without a manifest), else unbound-worker or lead; krn lane brief reserves the laneId and prints the start command; scope refuses unbound-worker writes, bound-lane writes outside worktree and targets, and lane writes under tasks/.
Proof: lifecycle suite cases D4a and D4b green; a verbatim PreToolUse krn-lane capture fixture binds the agent; legacy lanes keep writing; npm run fast PASS.
Files: src/lane/manifest.ts, src/hook/scope.ts, src/cli/lane.ts (brief, start --lane), test/lane/, test/hook/scope.test.ts
